company.name: Sanadme App
company.shortDescription: Sanad is an app aggregation technology that connects consumers and businesses to a network of nearby trucks and roadside assistance
company.description: Sanadme is an app. That provides road side assistance services. Their services include collection, delivery, transportation, logistics, relocation, shipping, moving, trucks, and towing services. Sanad is an app aggregation technology that instantly connects consumer & businesses to a network of nearby trucks and roadside assistance, waiting to service your needs. A logistics platform for last-mile optimization, it uses AI and big data to improve logistics. We provide solutions for on-demand and scheduled deliveries to help find the right balance between operational costs and service level with efficient and automated route planning, transparent delivery visibility and communication between operations, driver and consumer.
